title: Soundsystem Sub
description: A heavyweight FM sub dub bass: a deep sine carrier whose metallic FM overtones are driven by stepped index and harmonicity patterns on prime-ish clocks (7, 11, 13), so the tone reshapes through the loop without any LFO sweep. A short penv click snaps the attack, a ladder lowpass envelope keeps it round and warm, and classic dub delay echoes plus a touch of room smear each note into the void. Over 16 cycles the FM character, filter env and echo wetness drift out of phase and never quite resettle.
